# Onsective

> Onsective is a Toronto-headquartered global digital transformation consultancy. We deliver cloud, cybersecurity, AI automation, custom software, enterprise SEO, digital marketing, and brand management across 10 sovereign practice domains. Every engagement is principal-led, institutional-grade, and outcome-indexed.

Headquarters: 1111 Albion Rd, Etobicoke, Ontario M9V 1A6, Canada
Phone: +1-672-673-7900
Email: onsectivesoftware@outlook.com
Founded: 2023
Regions served: Canada, United States, United Kingdom, UAE, India, Singapore, Australia, Germany

## Services

- [IT Strategy](https://onsective.com/services/it-strategy): Enterprise technology strategy, portfolio rationalisation, target operating models.
- [Cloud Services](https://onsective.com/services/cloud-services): AWS, Azure, and GCP migration, FinOps, Kubernetes, DevSecOps — with Canadian data residency as a default.
- [Cybersecurity](https://onsective.com/services/cybersecurity): Zero-trust architecture, SOC audits, incident response, compliance (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PIPEDA, HIPAA).
- [Digital Experience](https://onsective.com/services/digital-experience): Product design, accessibility (WCAG 2.2), conversion engineering.
- [AI Automation](https://onsective.com/services/ai-automation): Enterprise LLM deployment, RAG, agentic workflows, MLOps.
- [Enterprise SEO](https://onsective.com/services/enterprise-seo): Technical SEO, content architecture, AI-search (GEO) optimisation.
- [Digital Marketing](https://onsective.com/services/digital-marketing): Paid search, paid social, content, lifecycle, and growth — with regulatory fluency for regulated industries.
- [Social Capital](https://onsective.com/services/social-capital): Community strategy, influencer, executive branding.
- [Custom Software](https://onsective.com/services/custom-software): SaaS, legal tech, fintech, and enterprise platform engineering.
- [Brand Management](https://onsective.com/services/brand-management): Positioning, identity systems, reputation.

- [Custom Legal Software Development in Toronto](https://onsective.com/guides/custom-legal-software-development-toronto): When to build vs buy, PIPEDA data residency, solicitor-client privilege, integration with LexisNexis and Westlaw.
- [Cloud Hosting Solutions for Canadian Law Firms](https://onsective.com/guides/cloud-hosting-canadian-law-firms): Azure Canada Central vs AWS ca-central-1 vs GCP Montreal, LSO By-Law 9 compliance, migration playbook.

- [AWS vs Azure vs GCP for Enterprise](https://onsective.com/guides/aws-vs-azure-vs-gcp): Principal-led cloud-provider comparison.
